documents.content:
---
title: Harbor sensor calibration policy
type: note
---

Current policy, effective 2026-08-01: Harbor sensor calibration interval is monthly. Compare each sensor with a certified reference. Replace any probe differing by more than 0.5 degrees Celsius. This replaces the 2025 quarterly interval.

documents.title: Harbor sensor inspection September 2026
documents.content:
---
title: Harbor sensor inspection September 2026
type: note
---

Harbor sensor calibration inspection on 2026-09-05: sensor A differed by 0.2 degrees; sensor B differed by 0.8 degrees Celsius. Sensor B requires replacement under the current 0.5-degree threshold. Repeat the calibration monthly.

title: Harbor calibration archive 2025

Historical policy dated 2025-02-01, superseded on 2026-08-01. Harbor sensor calibration interval was quarterly, with replacement above 1.0 degrees Celsius. Do not use this archived interval for current maintenance.

documents.title: Cedar backup retention policy
documents.content:
---
title: Cedar backup retention policy
type: note
---

Current Cedar backup retention policy, effective 2026-07-01: retain nightly backups for 35 days and monthly snapshots for 12 months. Restore drills run every month. The previous seven-day nightly retention is superseded.

documents.title: Cedar backup restore drill September
documents.content:
---
title: Cedar backup restore drill September
type: note
---

Cedar backup restore drill on 2026-09-07 completed in 18 minutes. Checksum verification passed for all 240 files. The approved recovery-time objective is 30 minutes; this drill met it. Retention settings were unchanged.

title: Cedar backup retention archive 2025
type: note
---

Cedar backup retention policy in 2025 kept nightly backups for seven days and monthly snapshots for six months. This historical policy expired on 2026-07-01. It does not describe current retention.

Atlas software launch policy approved 2026-08-20: production launch requires sign-off from both the security lead and the support lead. The release manager records both approvals. One manager alone cannot authorize launch.

documents.title: Juniper greenhouse watering policy
documents.content:
---
title: Juniper greenhouse watering policy
type: note
---

Current Juniper greenhouse watering policy, effective 2026-06-01: water seed trays when soil moisture falls below 30 percent. Check moisture each morning; do not water on a fixed daily schedule. Outdoor orchard irrigation is managed separately.

documents.title: Juniper greenhouse tray inspection
documents.content:
---
title: Juniper greenhouse tray inspection
type: note
---

Juniper greenhouse inspection on 2026-09-08 found tray C at 22 percent soil moisture and tray D at 38 percent. Water tray C only. Tray D is above the 30 percent watering threshold.

documents.title: Juniper greenhouse watering archive 2025
documents.content:
---
title: Juniper greenhouse watering archive 2025
type: note
---

Juniper greenhouse watering in 2025 followed a fixed daily schedule at 08:00. That policy was superseded on 2026-06-01 by a soil-moisture threshold. The old daily schedule is historical only.

documents.title: Juniper greenhouse watering index

title: Juniper greenhouse watering index

Juniper greenhouse watering policy, watering schedule archive and greenhouse tray inspection are separate records. This index repeats their names but does not specify when to water.

title: Juniper orchard watering plan

Juniper outdoor orchard watering runs each Tuesday for 45 minutes. Orchard trees use a drip line. These outdoor trees are separate from greenhouse seed trays; the greenhouse moisture threshold does not apply.

documents.title: Relay API token expiration policy
documents.content:
---
title: Relay API token expiration policy
type: note
---

Current Relay API token policy effective 2026-05-01: access tokens expire after 15 minutes. Refresh tokens expire after seven days and are rotated on every use. Reuse of a rotated refresh token revokes the session.

documents.title: Relay API token reuse incident
documents.content:
---
title: Relay API token reuse incident
type: note
---

Relay API incident on 2026-09-09: a client reused an already rotated refresh token. The service revoked the session as designed. The remedy is to store the latest refresh token atomically, not to lengthen access-token expiry.

documents.title: Relay API token expiration archive 2025
documents.content:
---
title: Relay API token expiration archive 2025
type: note
---

Relay API access-token expiration in 2025 was 24 hours. This historical policy was superseded on 2026-05-01. Refresh tokens were not rotated in that old implementation.

documents.content:

title: Relay API token expiration index

---

Relay API token expiration policy, refresh-token reuse incident and token expiration archive are listed here. This overview contains no authoritative duration or remediation procedure.
